symptom: An ambient Array.prototype.includes override returning true can make an unsupported result metric family appear authorized by the frozen protocol and can admit unknown oddsBasis values in the v0.1 runtime validator.
lesson: A frozen protocol array is not safely checked with a mutable Array.prototype.includes method when ambient prototype changes are in scope. A digest match does not compensate for a bypassed membership or enum check.
guardrail: Match permitted metric families by own indexed data descriptors and validate oddsBasis with direct literal comparisons; preserve the strict record validator and test prototype override in a synthetic research-only fixture. Never infer scoring authorization.
